prompt:
I've been terrible at keeping up with my friends and I want to finally get organized. I have a folder called raw_friend_notes/ in my home directory with rough notes about five people I care about — Carlos, Ana, Pedro, Marta, and João. The notes are messy and unstructured, just things I've jotted down over the years.

I need you to set up a proper personal friendship system for me, based on these notes. Each person should get their own dedicated file named exactly after them (e.g., carlos-martinez.md). They should be organized by how close we are — Carlos is basically my best friend and we talk almost every week, Ana is close but we see each other less, Pedro and João are more occasional, and Marta is someone I've lost touch with and want to reconnect with.

For each person, make sure to capture everything important from the notes: how we met, what's going on in their life, our interaction history (most recent stuff should be easy to find quickly), any follow-up items I need to remember, and their emotional state when we last spoke.

I also need a quick-reference overview file (index.md) listing all my friends, and a separate check-ins.md file that flags who I actually need to reach out to and why — based on how long it's been since we last talked versus how often we normally stay in touch.

All of this should live under a friends/ folder in my home directory.
